title: Anticuchos (Grilled Beef Heart Skewers with Green Sauce)
summary: Beef heart marinated for at least 4 hours in cider vinegar, ancho, paprika, cumin and garlic, grilled hot and fast to 63 °C, and served with corn, charred potatoes and a bright coriander-jalapeño sauce.

ingredients.item: beef heart, trimmed of fat, sinew and membrane, cut into 4 cm pieces 1.5 cm thick
garlic cloves, crushed to a paste
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the marinade
steps.text: Whisk the vinegar, garlic, ancho powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, salt, pepper and oil in the large bowl. Spoon 3 tbsp into the small bowl and chill it for basting, so the basting mix never touches raw meat.

steps.title: Marinate the heart
steps.text: Toss the heart in the rest, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 h or overnight. The vinegar seasons the dense meat right through and softens its surface for a better char.

steps.title: Cook the sides
steps.text: Boil the potatoes and corn in unsalted water for 15-20 min until the potatoes are just tender. Drain, slice the potatoes into thick rounds and keep both warm.

steps.title: Blend the sauce
steps.text: Whizz the coriander, jalapeño, garlic, lime juice, oil and pinch of salt with 2 tbsp water until smooth and bright green. Blending the oil in last-minute keeps the colour vivid.

steps.title: Skewer and grill
steps.text: Thread 3-4 pieces onto each soaked skewer, packing them closely so they stay juicy. Get the barbecue or griddle pan very hot, then cook for 2-3 min a side, brushing with the reserved marinade, until charred at the edges and the centre reaches 63 °C. Char the potato rounds and corn alongside.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest the skewers for 3 min so the juices settle. Serve hot with the potatoes, corn and green sauce for dipping.

tips: Trim the heart thoroughly; leftover silver membrane and sinew stay chewy however you cook them.
The most common mistake is overcooking: heart turns tough and livery past medium, so take it off at 63 °C.
Ask your butcher to trim and cut the heart for you.
storage: Best eaten hot off the grill. Chill leftovers for up to 2 days and reheat briefly in a hot pan until piping hot (74 °C); the green sauce keeps chilled for 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
